notes.title: First Major update!
notes.content:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/19/1494513213-shiness-adventure-gif.gif[/img]

Greetings everyone,

Shiness released a few weeks ago and we've carefully read and listened to your feedback since launch to work on a first update improving the game.

We focused on the most common reports and feedback to deploy a patch helping as many players as possible.

[b]This is a great week for Shiness as its first update is available today on Steam and the complete Original Soundtrack will be available tomorrow (disc version and digital version)![/b]

[b]The patch will also be available on consoles by the end of the month with some console-specific bug fixes[/b] such as: ambient sounds are properly played, AOE spells’ visual effects are properly displayed on the ground, the X and Y axis camera setting is now saved.

[b]One of the major improvements this patch brings to the game is about the camera system in combats[/b]. What you need to know about this feature:
[list][*]There are two camera modes in combats: Autolock (the camera automatically targets the enemy) and Free (the player can move the camera freely). [b]You can change modes in the Settings menu (Combat camera autolock: ON/OFF).[/b]
[*]Both modes are improved with the patch.
[*]The default camera for combats was Autolock mode in the launch version (Combat camera autolock: ON) and is now Free mode in the patched version (Combat camera autolock: OFF).[/list]
Please find below the full patch notes for the update (contains some story spoilers).

Thanks once again for your help and commitment to Shiness!

Have a nice time in Mahera,
-Team Enigami

[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/19/1494513517-shiness-12.jpg[/img]
 
[h1][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h1]

[b]Bug fix (content)[/b]
[list][*][Blocking issue fix] The Cohaya is now usable in the moutain after Mantara City Battle, preventing players from being stuck in the summit.
[*][Blocking issue fix] It's now not possible anymore to save during the cannons sequence of the Mantara City Battle.
[*][Blocking issue fix] In the quest "Three's a Crowd", Vrynn can't disapear outside the game area anymore, preventing players to be stuck with her.
[*][Blocking issue fix] In the Train Dungeon, players can't be stuck in combat after the alarm activation.
[*][Blocking issue fix] The side quest "Catch 'em all" can now be finished even if the player hunts Fauns in a different area than the Plain.
[*][Blocking issue fix] The Side quest "Music Maestra!" can now be finished even if the player get the requested item in a different area than the Plain.
[*]It's now impossible to gain exp above level 50 and go back to level 1.
[*]The achievement "It's really going down!" is fixed: money made by selling items is now taken into account.
[*]The puzzle to access the secret area Hall of Giants has been removed.
[*]Changes to the Meos' Palace to prevent characters skills from deactivating.
[*]Irys' rumors are now properly updated with side quests.
[*]In combat, enemies now always die when falling.
[*]Fix of an issue displaying a red HP gauge in combat.
[*]Fix of a bug preventing Train Dungeon alarms from activating.
[*]Fix of a bug opening several chests in the same time and preventing the access from some specific rewards.
[*]In the Mountain, players can't avoid the fight against Father.
[*]Fix of various sound issues.[/list]
[b]Bug fix (performances and parameters)[/b]
[list][*]Fix of video stuttering with AMD processors.
[*]Improvement of the "Show Vegetation" option, now displaying rocks when it is set to OFF.
[*]The game now starts with the keyboard/mouse or controller interface depending on what's used on the Main Screen.
[*]In the options, players can now change gauge values faster.[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Addition of hints in the loading screens.
[*]New mentions of the Cohaya of Xaham in various lines.
[*]A few elements have been removed in the environments to improve comfort during combats.
[*]Bushes now disappear in combat to improve visibility.
[*]Items in the fighting area disappear at a longer range.
[*]Improvement of the Autolock combat camera mode.
[*]Improvement of the Free combat camera mode.
[*]The Hyper validation input can't be interrupted anymore.
[*]The Elemental doors now request the same Shi Value for each element.
[*]New defeat message when losing during the cannons sequence of the Mantara City Battle.
[*]A Bloodor is now displayed on a save where the player has suffered at least one Game Over.[/list]

notes.content: French indie JRPG-looking Kickstarter project (phew!) Shiness [official site] is now out and has a launch trailer to prove it. The name relates to this particular game’s version of a linking spiritual/life-giving energy called Shi, which I assume is a reference to qi. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Shiness: The Lightning Kingdom
notes.content:
Shiness: The Lightning Kingdom is Now Available on Steam!

Shiness is an Action-RPG developed by indie development studio Enigami, which will let you travel in a captivating universe doomed to destruction ever since the fragmentation of the planet Mahera...

notes.title: Watch the Launch Trailer!
notes.content:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/16/1492507408-shiness-bossfight-gif.gif[/img]

[b]Shiness: The Lightning Kingdom is available today![/b]

Watch our launch trailer promising to take you on a journey through an enthralling universe on the verge of collapse, following the fragmentation of the planet Mahera. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eimcnM6WtVM
After crash-landing in a hostile land, Chado and his friends find themselves in the middle of a conflict between kingdoms. 

The Shiness universe was born over 20 years ago from the pen strokes of Samir Rebib, Artistic Director of the studio. We've put all our energy and passion into Shiness, and a child's dream has finally turned a fully-fleshed indie-RPG with a bold personality! 

[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/16/1492507666-shiness-12.jpg[/img]

In Shiness, take control of Chado and his four friends as they journey across a fractured world beset by a war between multiple factions. Combat is inspired by traditional fighting games, mixing fast-paced combos, parrying, blocking, and powerful magical abilities distinct for each character. 

Your party members' usefulness isn't limited to just combat - manipulate the environments around you with abilities such as Kayenne's telekinesis and Askel's far-reaching whip. 

[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/16/1492507666-shiness-10.jpg[/img]

Gain experience and level up after fights, while progressing in the storyline or by accomplishing numerous side quests. Evolve your characters, learn new skills and spells, and become the hero who will unify the civilizations of Mahera. 

[b]Shiness: The Lightning Kingdom is available today for download! Embark upon your epic journey today on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and PC.[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/366640

notes.title: Meet Shiness' Roster!
notes.content:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/14/1491554810-shiness-character-1.gif[/img]

[b]Our upcoming Action-RPG Shiness arrives 18 April for download on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and PC! 

In today's Characters Trailer, meet the eclectic band of fighters you'll take control of as you explore, quest and battle across the magical world of Mahera.[/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gHa3WE_11Q4
Shiness' characters and story were first birthed over 20 years ago from the pen strokes of a young Samir Rebib, co-founder of Enigami. 

Now, after a successful Kickstarter campaign and with the help of publisher Focus Home Interactive, this young team is close to releasing their first game - featuring 5 playable characters with distinct playstyles and personalities:
[list][*][b]Chado[/b] - This daring young Waki dreams of travelling far beyond his home town Kimpao - and this desire quickly lands him in big trouble![/list]
[list][*][b]Poky[/b] - A faithful friend to Chado, Poky has an incredible talent for engineering that makes up for his lack of courage.[/list]
[list][*][b]Rosalya[/b] - Shy but loyal to the party, Rosalya has a powerful affinity with fire and is on the search for a mysterious truth.[/list]
[list][*][b]Askel[/b] - A formidable young mercenary, the enigmatic Askel already has a far-reaching reputation in Mahera. [/list]
[list][*][b]Kayenne[/b] - A strong, natural born leader, Kayenne remains calm in even the most difficult situations.[/list]

Directly control your party members in hyper-dynamic combat - each character has powerful magical abilities and their own devastating Hyper Combos! 

Though battles are 1v1 in classic fighting game tradition, party members can cast spells from the sidelines and be swapped out through the tag team system.

[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/14/1491555951-shiness-12.jpg[/img]

Outside battle, the open, puzzle-filled environments give party members plenty of opportunities to shine. From Kayenne's telekinetic talents to Rosalya's use of fire to reveal hidden entrances, use potent abilities to overcome any obstacle that stands in your way. 

[b]Shiness: The Lightning Kingdom arrives for download on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and PC on 18 April 2017. 

Pre-orders for PC are open on Steam, and include the Official Shiness Manga, the Original Soundtrack and 15% off the game's price.[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/366640

notes.title: Watch the Overview Trailer!
notes.content:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/07/1487239451-shiness-overview-gif-3.gif[/img]

[b]Shiness brings to light the depth of its gameplay and enthralling universe in a brand new video![/b]

While Shiness releases in just a few weeks on PS4, Xbox One and PC, its universe was born over 20 years ago from the pen strokes of our artistic director, Samir Rebib. Now the development phase is nearing conclusion, we keep pumping all our energy and passion into Shiness, and a child's dream is finally becoming an indie-RPG with a bold personality!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CxTjMu7mIKU
Today's video invites you to the magic world of Shiness! Explore the world, and use your characters' special powers – Kayenne's telekinesis, Poky's electromagnetic fields manipulation, and more – to progress in your adventure and find precious parchments, which are key to devastating spells and powerful combat techniques. 

[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/07/1487239760-shiness-09.jpg[/img]

Throughout your quest, take part in hyper-dynamic combat inspired by traditional fighting games, combining combos, special moves, magic, elemental affinities and devastating "finish moves". As you complete quests and battles, you will gain experience and levels, develop your characters and recruit new playable companions on your team. 

[b]Shiness is coming soon to PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC! Stay tuned![/b] 

Pre-orders for PC are already open on Steam, including the Official Shiness Manga, the Original Soundtrack and 15% off the game's price.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/366640

notes.title: Go Behind The Scenes!
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/38/1474362060-shiness-villain-gif.gif[/img]
Hey everyone!

We just released a behind-the-scenes trailer, in which you can discover the 20-year journey of Shiness - from imaginary universe to Action-RPG!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t9IZhOc_sRQ

Enigami tells us more about Shiness' fast-paced battle system, which blends RPG elements with classic fighting game mechanics. Mastering the real-time blocking, parrying, dodging and combos are key to progressing in your quest, with distinct playstyles across 5 different characters. 

Each character also has their own special abilities used outside of battle, vital for resolving the many puzzles scattered across the lands of Shiness. 

Shiness features its own unique language, created in full just for this mythical universe - this intricate language helps players feel totally immersed in the world of Shiness. The orchestral soundtrack, composed entirely by Enigami director Hazem Hawash, only enriches this extraordinary world even further. 

[b]Harness the power of Shi alongside Chado and his allies in Shiness: The Lightning Kingdom, coming to PlayStation 4, Xbox One and PC this December.[/b]

[b]Pre-order on Steam today, and receive the Official Shiness Manga, the Original Soundtrack, and 15% off the game's price![/b]

notes.title: Preorders start next week!
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/35/1472727619-shiness-adventure-gif.gif[/img]

[b]We're pleased to reveal more images of Shiness' world and unveil its coming pre-order offer![/b]

Next week, players will have the chance to pre-order the game on Steam, benefitting from exclusive bonuses. While [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/366640/announcements/detail/868453475016372652]Shiness’ Gamescom Trailer[/url] brought more information about the story of the game, the images unveiled today will embark you further into the magical and inhospitable lands that make up the world of Shiness. 

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/35/1472727744-shiness-09-logo.jpg[/img]

Walk deep inside the corrupted forest of Meonis, a land originally inhabited by Meonians. This old civilization once lived in harmony with the nature, but fled to Mantara City in order to escape the Curse of Adorn. 

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/35/1472727744-shiness-10-logo.jpg[/img]

Meonis forest is now infested by evil creatures from the obscure Shi, and home to the palace of the dead King Meos, a dark place where only the bravest of heroes would dare visit.

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/35/1472727744-shiness-12-logo.jpg[/img]

Further in the North, at the Peak of Shiyawo Mountains, Chado observes the Hall of Giants - the only gate for exiled people to access the lands of Adorya.

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/35/1472727744-shiness-11-logo.jpg[/img]

Players will have the chance to pre-order Shiness on Steam starting next [list][*]15% off the price of the game
[*]The first 129 pages of the Official Shiness Manga, telling the story of our heroes before the game’s beginning
[*]The Shiness Original Soundtrack[/list]

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/35/1472731059-shiness-preorder-nextweek.jpg[/img]

[b]Shiness: The Lightning Kingdom releases this fall on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and PC.[/b]

notes.title: Watch the Gamescom Trailer
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/33/1471511417-shiness-gif-1.gif[/img]

[b]Enigami's Action-RPG, Shiness: The Lightning Kingdom, will release at the end of the year on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and PC.[/b]

Today's Gamescom Trailer reveals more about the story of Shiness, chronicling the journey of a young Waki, Chado, who has left his home in search for the mythical “Land of Life”.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BUBDP5Y8YPA

Explore a new world and battle enemies in intense 1 versus 1 duels by combining fighting game mechanics with magic, quests, and a fantasy adventure. 

After a fateful meeting with a mysterious being called Terra, a spirit that only he can see, Chado is given a mission to find the “Land of Life”. Hidden in this land are the secrets of Shi, the magic that governs the world. 

In Chado's way, a brutal war erupts from two sister-kingdoms, Adorya and Adorn, leaving the shattered world of Mahera in the middle of a power-struggle. But are things really as they seem? Conspiracies and the dastardly forces of evil await Chado and his new allies. Your decisions will determine the destiny of the planet and the outcome of the war. 

[b]Harness the power of Shi alongside Chado and his allies in Shiness: The Lightning Kingdom. Coming in 2016 on PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC![/b]
